Name: CP - Better Fishing Additions for Better Fishing and Beach Foraging Mod
Author: plurffle
Description:
[center][b][size=6]UPDATE AS OF JUNE 2025:[/size]
[/b][size=5]Cometkins has completed their Better Fishing and Beach Foraging mod, therefore this mod is obsolete! Go support the original creator, their art is amazing! <3[/size][/center]


This mod was made to serve as an extension for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915](WIP) Better Fishing and Beach Foraging[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13136]Fish and Aquarium reskin for -Better Fishing and Beach Foraging-[/url] mods to fill up the unfinished gaps.

I just really like using their mods because of how unique and colorful the fishes looked in-game, but I was a little bummed to see that some of the fishes still didn't have retextures, so I took it upon myself to make them.

This was made for personal use, but I figured I'd share them publicly here. This mod is complete as of version 1.2.0, so having this mod along with the other two mods should ensure that you'll have a bit more splashes of colors in your oceans and rivers (I highly recommend downloading the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url] mod for this!).

This mod comes with a config that allows you to pick and choose which sprite replacers you'd like to use. This also comes with two versions of the blobfish (normal version and decompressed version).

[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]
[b][size=3]Q: [/size]How to install this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A:[/b] [/size]Unzip the zip file and place the "(CP) Better Fishing Additions" folder in your Mods folder.

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]I do not have the mobile version of the game, but I assume it should be work just fine in there since this is a Content Patcher mod. This should definitely work in multiplayer!

[img]https://imgur.com/LxEgarJ.png[/img]
[b]Here are some of my recommended mods for your fish-keeping needs![/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10330719]Decorated Fish Tank 장식된 어항 리텍[/url] (not available on nexusmods)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11388]Increased Fish Tank Capacity[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14267]Sizable Fish[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url]
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/lT7uwQV.png[/img]
Major credits to cometkins for their gorgeous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915]Better Fishing and Beach Foraging[/url][b] [/b]mod! That mod is the only reason why I decided to try and start drawing some fishes! <3 My attempt at mimicking the style isn't the best, but I think I did a [i]decent[/i] enough job. I'll definitely update the sprites a bit more if I could figure out how to tweak them better!



I have a Ko-fi account! If you like my works, feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
